scope: Proposition 4.6 (Integral frame comparison) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Put Ym = [Xm/P3]. There is an equivalence of v-stacks over k Ym ≃ [Em/(GLr(Zp) × Pm)]. (4.4) It carries an actual universal sequence 0 −→ Lr ⊗Zp O −→ V3 −→ Vm −→ 0, (4.5) where Lr is the integral étale Tate local system and Vs are Ps-structured forms. The two presentations give the classifying maps to BP3, B GLr(Zp) and BPm, and their determinant characters satisfy Nrd3 = det GLr Nrdm . (4.6) With the convention (A, b)e = A∗((b−1)∗e) for extension classes, the kernel scalar u acts on Nr m by u and the quotient scalar u by u−1. For m = 2, let e X2 be the full connected-marking tower. It admits a normalized integral étale generator, fixed by H = ker(Nrd : P3 → Z× p ). There are compatible equivalences e X2 ≃ Surj(V3, V2), [ e X2/H] ≃ N∗ 2 . (4.7) The full residual norm quotient acts in the second equivalence by scalar units, in the kernel convention just specified. No section of P3 → Z× p is involved.
